title: Stop Leaving Money on the Table: Building a Dynamic Pricing Agent
summary: Static pricing is dead. Learn how to build a Growth Revenue Agent that continuously analyzes competitor inventory and dynamically adjusts prices via the Shopify API to maximize profit margin.

body.text: Stop Leaving Money on the Table: Building a Dynamic Pricing Agent

elements.text: Static pricing is dead. If a viral TikTok video causes your primary competitor to run out of stock, your price should instantly increase to capture the surplus demand. In this guide, we will build a

elements.definition: An autonomous agent focused on optimizing top-line revenue and profit margins through algorithmic decision-making.

elements.text: that acts as an algorithmic Wall Street trader for your e-commerce SKUs, autonomously pushing price updates to Stripe or Shopify.
Prerequisites: Familiarity with the Shopify Admin API, web scraping techniques, and Python.

The agent operates on a continuous market-watch loop. It ingests three main data streams: your internal inventory count, competitor stock statuses (via scraping or third-party APIs), and current market demand indicators. When it detects a scarcity event (e.g., Competitor A is 'Out of Stock'), the agent consults its pricing elasticity model and executes a GraphQL mutation to instantly raise your product's price.

elements.text: The core logic requires polling the competitor state and pushing an update to your storefront.

def evaluate_pricing(sku_id, current_price):
    competitor_stock = scraper.check_competitor_inventory(sku_id)
    
    if competitor_stock == 0:
        print(f'[SCARCITY DETECTED] Competitor out of stock for {sku_id}')
        
        # Agent decides to increase price by 15%
        new_price = current_price * 1.15
        
        # Push update to Shopify GraphQL API
        shopify_api.update_product_price(sku_id, new_price)
        slack.notify(f'💰 Price for {sku_id} increased to ${new_price:.2f}')
        
        return new_price
    return current_price

elements.text: Dynamic pricing can lead to severe brand reputation damage if perceived as price gouging (e.g., raising the price of bottled water during a hurricane). You must implement strict
in your agent's configuration to prevent algorithms from pushing prices beyond acceptable ethical and market limits.

To validate the agent, spin up a mock competitor API endpoint that returns `stock: 0`. Run your agent and verify that it successfully authenticates with the Shopify Sandbox API and updates the variant price. Check the agent's JSON output for the margin projection.
We've built an autonomous pricing agent that stops you from leaving money on the table during critical demand spikes, turning your e-commerce platform into a dynamic, algorithmic trading desk.
